interface_detail: http/https/socks5, stated on the page, and an API for automated purchase and management ("API对接，支持自动化采购管理"), plus a documentation centre.

chaining: The upstream sees a pooled dynamic address or an exclusive static address. The static product is labelled "真实住宅ISP代理 100%真人住宅属性" (real residential ISP proxy); no delivered address was seen, so the class is unverified.

dynamic residential is metered per GB; the pack sizes and prices are unverified
